title: EngravePlugin
description: A plugin that lets the player engrave an item with their name and timestamp.
body:
This plugin adds one item - the engraver. It is made via blasting an iron ingot, and it is added to any gear item in an anvil to stamp it with the player's IGN and the date (either real world, minecraft world or lore world). 

Configuration for custom day and year length, custom date marker, real life world time. Also colour of lore and whether the engraver is obtainable in survival.

To see the engraver item, use the Plugin Resourcepack - https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/engravepluginpack

Credits: ikhom - the idea.
